column2: 1 REQ-FUN-001 Pick and place by classification
column3: The cell shall pick each part delivered to the pick position and place it in the OK bin or the reject bin according to its classification.
The vision function shall classify each part as OK or NOK before the robot picks it.

column2: 5 REQ-FUN-003 Vision timeout treated as NOK
column3: If no classification result is available within 500 ms (A) of the camera trigger, the cell shall treat the part as NOK and raise a warning.
The cell shall provide the modes Automatic, Manual (teach), Maintenance and Fault, with at most one mode active at any time.

column2: 7 REQ-FUN-005 Mode change only when stopped
column3: A mode change shall be possible only while the robot is stopped.
The cell shall count OK, NOK and fault events and log each with a timestamp.
column4: STK-01 Plant manager, STK-05 Quality manager

column3: In Automatic mode the cycle time shall not exceed 3.0 s (A) for 95 % of cycles.
The place position error shall not exceed 1.0 mm (A).
The vision function shall classify at least 98 % (A) of parts correctly and pass at most 0.5 % (A) of NOK parts as OK.
Availability shall be at least 95 % (A) over an 8 h shift, excluding planned maintenance.
The mass of part plus gripper shall not exceed 50 % (A) of the robot rated payload.
A documented risk assessment following the ISO 12100 method shall exist for the cell and define the required performance level of each safety function.
column4: STK-04 Safety officer / conformity body; ISO 12100, ISO 10218-2

column3: Actuating any emergency stop device shall stop all hazardous motion, with the stop category chosen from the risk assessment.
column4: STK-04 Safety officer / conformity body; ISO 13850, IEC 60204-1

column3: Opening the interlocked access door in Automatic mode shall trigger a protective stop within T_door (TBC) and prevent restart until a deliberate reset.
column4: STK-04 Safety officer / conformity body; ISO 14119

column3: Interrupting the light curtain at the bin exchange opening shall trigger a protective stop within T_lc (TBC).
column4: STK-04 Safety officer / conformity body; IEC 61496

column3: Each safety function shall reach the performance level required by REQ SAF-001 (working assumption: PL d, category 3, TBC).
In Manual mode the cell shall limit the tool centre point speed to 250 mm/s (TBC against ISO 10218) and permit motion only while the operator holds an enabling device.

column2: 20 REQ-SAF-007 Stopping time against safety distance
column3: The total stopping time (detection, processing, braking) shall be short enough that the distance between each safeguard and the hazard is at least the minimum safety distance calculated per ISO 13855.

column2: 21 REQ-SAF-008 Gripper holds on power loss
column3: On loss of power or air, the cell shall retain the part in the gripper and keep the robot stopped.
column4: STK-04 Safety officer / conformity body; risk assessment

column3: The cell shall keep each safety function operating after a single fault and bring a detected fault to the safe state.

column2: 23 REQ-SAF-010 Safety functions in a safety-rated controller
column3: Safety functions shall be implemented in a safety-rated controller without relying on the standard PLC.
The PLC and the robot controller shall exchange commands and status over one industrial protocol (to be chosen) with a cycle time of at most 10 ms (A).
The vision subsystem shall return a classification result to the PLC within 300 ms (A) of the camera trigger.
The cell shall operate from a 230 V AC (+/- 10 %, A) mains supply and a 24 V DC control supply.
The cell shall operate at 5 to 40 degrees C and at most 80 % relative humidity, non-condensing (A).
The cell shall meet the EMC immunity and emission limits for industrial environments.
Network-connected components shall require authentication for configuration changes and have remote access disabled by default.
The information for use shall define the inspection and test intervals of every safety function.
column4: STK-04 Safety officer / conformity body; ISO 10218-2 (information for use)

column3: A worn gripper pad shall be replaceable within 15 min (A) using standard tools.

column2: 32 REQ-SAF-011 No restart after power restoration
column3: After a loss and restoration of power, the cell shall remain stopped until a deliberate reset is performed.
The cell shall provide a lockable means to isolate and depressurise the compressed air supply before maintenance work on the gripper.

column2: 34 REQ-SAF-013 No robot entry during bin exchange
column3: While a bin exchange is in progress, the robot shall be prevented from moving into the bin-exchange zone.
